Hugo Boss Finance, Operations Chief Steps Down
Hugo Boss said Yves Mueller, the company's chief financial and operating officer, is stepping down at his own request and will be succeeded by company veteran Ivica Maric.

The German fashion company said Monday that Maric would assume responsibility for finance and operations on the group's managing board from Thursday. Maric has held several roles during a two-decade career at the company and currently serves as executive vice president for business operations.
Mueller joined Hugo Boss as CFO in December 2017 and added responsibility for operations in May 2022, the company said. His departure is due to personal reasons, Hugo Boss said.
